content:
Manchester United have strengthened their midfield with the arrival of Manuel Ugarte from Paris Saint-Germain in a deal worth €50m plus a further €10m in bonuses. The 23-year-old Uruguay international has signed a five-year contract, with the option of an additional year, and becomes another key addition for Erik ten Hag as the club continue to reshape the squad.

Ugarte spoke with enthusiasm about the move, saying he was excited to join a club with such history and global appeal. He said the discussion about the club’s direction convinced him that this was the right next step in his career, and he promised to give everything for his teammates as he aims to help bring major honours back to Manchester.

United’s sporting director Dan Ashworth said the club had identified Ugarte as one of their main targets for the summer and were delighted to complete the deal. The signing gives Ten Hag more strength in central midfield and adds another experienced option to a squad the club believe can compete at a higher level.

The move is another sign of United’s ambition this summer, with the club hoping that fresh arrivals can help restore consistency, confidence, and a genuine challenge for silverware. Supporters will now be eager to see Ugarte in action as he begins his spell at Old Trafford. Any other questions?
